result.line: No bridge contract on hyperevm: the only contract is Bridge2 0x2Df1c51E09aECF9cacB7bc98cB1742757f163dF7 on Arbitrum (DefiLlama bridges-server adapter, arbitrum-only; eth_getCode 0x on hyperevm, non-0x on arbitrum same run); hyperevm surface is native system contracts only - 0x2222..2 bare receive() (calldata==0), 0x20..token_index EOAs, CoreWriter 0x3333..3333 sendRawAction(bytes) 0x17938e13 caller burns ~25-47k gas - zero stranger-paid functions; .587B of the .62B TVL is HyperCore-native state (api.llama.fi 2026-11-18).
